result.reason: The clause achieves most of the preferred position: Customer may assign without consent to an Affiliate or qualifying successor, IBM assignments require Customer consent not to be unreasonably withheld, and Customer change of control creates no termination right. However, it omits the required absolute prohibition on IBM assigning to a Customer competitor. It also adds suspension and re-pricing restrictions beyond the stated playbook requirement, so the revision is not strictly minimal. Unrelated commercial terms are otherwise preserved, and the drafting is generally professional.
